bind_note: Armature rest in the glb == null-add pose evaluated on the Actor_B rig (unkeyed channels at rig rest). glTF inverse binds are therefore inverse(null-add global); they do not depend on the Skeleton3D rest.
space: Godot skeleton space: +Y up, character faces +Z (Blender (x, y, z) -> (x, z, -y)).

helpers.note: Procedural helper bones driven at runtime by scripts/player/character_body.gd (CharacterBodyMesh.HELPERS must match this table).

transform_format: 12 floats: basis x, y, z columns, then origin
provenance: Skeleton, bone names and bind pose: Actor_B rig converted from extracted game animation data (see Player_Animation_Project/ASSET_AUTHORIZATION.md). Mesh geometry: generated procedurally by this script.
